title: dev-06: Model — Support types (Extensions, Converter, Errors)
description: Implement Extensions (OptionSet stub with .canonical = [] and .all), Converter (value type stubs .empty and .bundled), and CooklangError (error enum with case parse(message: String, line: Int, column: Int)) in their own source files.
acceptance_criteria: Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/Extensions.swift declares public struct Extensions: OptionSet, Sendable with rawValue: Int, static let canonical = Extensions([]), and static let all.
Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/Converter.swift declares public struct Converter: Sendable with static let empty and static let bundled (stub, no conversion logic).
Packages/CookbookCore/Sources/CookbookCore/Errors.swift declares public enum CooklangError: Error, Sendable with case parse(message: String, line: Int, column: Int).
